note: Five outcomes, not two. `cannot-tell` and `not-tested` are results, not failures to hide: conflating either with `pass` is how an incomplete scanner looks healthy.

values.label: Requirement does not apply to this content
Examined, but the outcome needs human judgement
Not examined — no rule ran, or the content was never reached

separate_axes.conformance: met / not met / not applicable, per criterion and level
separate_axes.severity: user impact if unresolved — blocker, serious, moderate, minor
separate_axes.confidence: how certain the result is — definite, probable, possible
separate_axes.coverage: how much of the space was actually examined

warning: Keep these four apart. A high automated conformance score over low coverage says almost nothing, and averaging them into one number destroys the information.
